card.name: Start of a split drug or proper name
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is split into parts, mostly a drug name (amlodipine, bosentan, cefepime, apomorphine) or a ferritin-type lab term. Also seen in some proper names.

modes.label: Drug name starts
modes.description: First piece of a drug name after words like 'on', 'of' or 'Concomitant use of'.
modes.example: Limit the dose of simvastatin in patients on<< a>>mlodipine to 20

modes.label: Lab terms and brand names
modes.description: Opening piece of a lab test or capitalized brand name.
modes.example: Interrupt treatment when serum<< ferr>>itin is less than 300

modes.label: Other names and compounds
modes.description: First piece of a place name, surname or compound noun in general text.

card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of a long drug or lab-test name that the model has not yet finished reading.
